_doc: Path skills for levels 3-10 (Fable, 2026-11-10; design in docs/SKILLS.md). Everyone is a Wanderer at 1-2, picks a Path at 3 (ruling 2/29), a Spec at 10 that REPLACES these as the main kit (ruling 10) - so every Path skill here is also written to stay useful as a utility after 10 (an interrupt, a dash, a shield, a mark). FIELDS are exactly the M9 engine vocabulary: name, owner, tree, reqLevel, maxRank (1-10), prereq (ids that need rank >= 1 first), kind (active|passive|synergy), desc (player text; {mult} renders as the weapon multiplier in percent, {dmg} the damage/heal/absorb total at the player's level and rank, {secs} the main duration), cost ({mana|rage|energy: n}), costPerRank (added to the cost per rank above 1), cast (seconds; moving cancels), channel (seconds; one tick per second, moving cancels), cd (seconds), gcd (false = does not use nor trigger the 1.5 s global cooldown), range (metres; 0 = the equipped weapon's reach, so a bow user Notches from 25 m and a dagger user from 2), target, effects/passive/synergy. EFFECT CONVENTIONS: `perRank: { field: increment }` adds the increment per rank above 1; when the field is an array (`base`) the increment is added element-wise. `base: [a, b]` = a + b x level. `weapon` = one hit of the equipped weapon x mult (through melee/ranged power, hit, dodge, block, armour, crit). `damage`/`bolt`/`dot` are spells (x spellPower, through resist, 96% base hit). `heal`/`hot`/`shield` x healPower. `resource` effects always go to the CASTER (Headlong finds rage, Sunlash refunds mana). `area` applies its inner effects to every enemy (or ally, for heal/hot/shield/buff) in the shape at the moment it lands; the client draws the shape for the player too. `debuff` kinds: slow|stun|silence|root|armourDown|damageDown|weaken. `mark` = the target takes +pct% damage from EVERYONE for secs (a co-op setup). PASSIVE UNITS: crit/dodge/blockChance are whole percentage points; armourPct/attackSpeed/castSpeed/moveSpeed/threat/rageGen/energyRegen/resistAll/critDamage/spellPower/healPower/meleePower/rangedPower/maxHp/maxMana are percent (+5 = x1.05); hpRegen/manaRegen are per second; lifeOnHit is flat per hit. A SYNERGY node raises another skill's damage/heal/duration/radius by pctPerRank x its own rank. STARTERS are granted at rank 1 for free at the Path pick. Nothing here needs a field outside the vocabulary; the `wishlist` lists the engine additions that would make four skills better, each with the exact rule.

resources._doc: Tuned for a 1.5 s GCD and 10-30 s fights. In a pack fight a sword Fighter gains ~9 rage a second (autos 4.8 + hits taken ~4), i.e. ~13 a GCD, so a 15-20 rage skill every GCD is sustainable and a 40-rage Breaker Blow lands every third or fourth. A Rogue gains 15 energy a GCD plus the 100 bar, so a 30 s fight has ~400 energy: Notch every 8 s, a finisher most GCDs, lean at the end. Mana has no Path bonus: the well comes from Intellect (5 mana a point) and Spirit (regen), which is what a caster spends attribute points on; a level-10 Mage with ~45 points in Intellect has ~300 mana and ~3.5 regen, which pays for ~20 casts in 30 s at the costs below and then runs lean (ruling 23: potions).

mana.regen: derived().manaRegen, in and out of combat

wandererSkillsAfterPath._doc: A Fighter has no mana bar and a Rogue has no mana bar, so their Wanderer skills (sure_strike, spark, field_mend, shove) are re-priced in the Path resource with the same number: mana n -> rage n, and mana n -> energy 2n. Mage and Healer keep the mana costs. Spark and Field Mend stay castable by everyone (a Fighter can still mend a friend out of combat), they are just slow.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.blurb: The wall that hits back. Every blow you land or take puts temper in your blood; spend it on wide swings and one breaking blow. Mail now, plate at ten.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.blurb: Set it up, then finish it. Notch a target so everyone's blows go deeper, then cut from behind or draw a long shot. Energy comes back on its own; your job is to spend it well.

mage.name: Mage
mage.blurb: Cast, step, cast. A slow bolt that hurts, a ring of frost that slows the pack, a lance you throw on the move, and a wall of air when they get close. Cloth only - you are never where they are.

healer.name: Healer
healer.blurb: The light that bites. Mend one friend, bathe the party in Radiance, bless the ground they stand on - and lash the enemy with sunlight that pays for the next heal.

sure_strike.name: Sure Strike
sure_strike.desc: A careful blow for {mult} of your weapon's damage.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Throw a crackling spark for {dmg} storm damage. Takes a moment to cast.

field_mend.name: Field Mend
field_mend.desc: Bind your own or a friend's wounds for {dmg}. Works on yourself if nobody is picked.

shove.name: Shove
shove.desc: Knock your target off balance for {mult} weapon damage, stopping whatever it is casting. Does not use the global cooldown.

fighter_charge.name: Headlong
fighter_charge.desc: Rush your target from up to 20 m, hit it for {mult} weapon damage and arrive with temper in your blood. Does not use the global cooldown.

fighter_rend.name: Deep Gash
fighter_rend.desc: Open a wound for {mult} weapon damage that keeps bleeding for {secs} seconds. Your bread and butter against anything with a big health bar.

fighter_cleave.name: Wide Swing
fighter_cleave.desc: Swing through everything in front of you for {mult} weapon damage each. The answer to a pack.

fighter_shield_slam.name: Hard Stop
fighter_shield_slam.desc: Slam your shield boss (or your pommel) into the target for {mult} weapon damage: it stops whatever it was casting for {secs} seconds and turns on you. Does not use the global cooldown.

fighter_scar_tissue.name: Scar Tissue
fighter_scar_tissue.desc: Old wounds make hard skin. Your armour counts for more.

fighter_war_cry.name: Rallying Roar
fighter_war_cry.desc: A roar that puts heart into your friends (+damage for {secs} seconds) and takes it out of every enemy within 8 m (they hit softer for 6 seconds).

fighter_breaker_blow.name: Breaker Blow
fighter_breaker_blow.desc: Pour your temper into one blow for {mult} weapon damage that cracks the target's armour for {secs} seconds. The thing you have been building up to.

fighter_long_grudge.name: Long Grudge
fighter_long_grudge.desc: You hold on to anger. Every hit you land or take gives more temper.

fighter_follow_through.name: Follow Through
fighter_follow_through.desc: Wide Swing carries through with the whole shoulder: more damage per rank.

fighter_dig_in.name: Dig In
fighter_dig_in.desc: Plant your feet: +armour and a shield of {dmg} for {secs} seconds, and you find 20 temper. The button for when the fight goes wrong. Does not use the global cooldown.

rogue_notch.name: Notch
rogue_notch.desc: A quick cut for {mult} weapon damage that notches the target: for {secs} seconds it takes more damage from everyone. Set it up, then finish it.

rogue_backstab.name: Back Cut
rogue_backstab.desc: A deep cut from behind for {mult} weapon damage. Only works when you are behind the target - let the brute face your friend, or circle it.

rogue_slip_step.name: Slip Step
rogue_slip_step.desc: Spring 6 m back and dodge better for 3 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

rogue_aimed_shot.name: Long Draw
rogue_aimed_shot.desc: Draw to the ear and loose for {mult} weapon damage. Needs a bow or crossbow; takes a moment, and moving spoils it.

rogue_poison_coat.name: Poison Coat
rogue_poison_coat.desc: Coat the edge and drive it in: {mult} weapon damage, then poison for {secs} seconds. Stack it on the brute while you work the rest of the pack.

rogue_hush_knife.name: Hush Knife
rogue_hush_knife.desc: A thrown knife from the belt for {mult} weapon damage that stops a cast for {secs} seconds. Works at 20 m with any weapon. Does not use the global cooldown.

rogue_light_feet.name: Light Feet
rogue_light_feet.desc: You are not where the blow lands. More dodge.

rogue_knife_fan.name: Knife Fan
rogue_knife_fan.desc: Fling a fan of knives across everything in front of you for {mult} weapon damage each. The swarm answer.

rogue_keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
rogue_keen_edge.desc: You know where the gaps are. More critical hits.

rogue_deeper_cut.name: Deeper Cut
rogue_deeper_cut.desc: Back Cut goes in to the hilt: more damage per rank.

rogue_fletchers_eye.name: Fletcher's Eye
rogue_fletchers_eye.desc: Long Draw finds the seam in the armour: more damage per rank.

mage_firebolt.name: Cinder Bolt
mage_firebolt.desc: A slow, heavy bolt of fire for {dmg} damage. Your biggest hit; cast it when nothing is in your face.

mage_frost_ring.name: Frost Ring
mage_frost_ring.desc: Frost bursts out of you: {dmg} frost damage to everything within 6 m and they move at half speed for {secs} seconds. Then walk away and cast.

mage_shift.name: Shift
mage_shift.desc: Step 8 m through the air in the direction you are moving. Does not use the global cooldown.

mage_storm_lance.name: Storm Lance
mage_storm_lance.desc: Hurl a lance of lightning for {dmg} storm damage. Instant - throw it while you walk.

mage_stifle.name: Stifle
mage_stifle.desc: Snatch the air out of a caster's mouth: stops its cast and keeps it quiet for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

mage_ward.name: Ward
mage_ward.desc: A wall of still air absorbs {dmg} damage for {secs} seconds - about one point of damage per point of mana. Your armour, since cloth is not.

mage_thunderhead.name: Thunderhead
mage_thunderhead.desc: Call a storm cloud over a spot and hold it there for {secs} seconds: lightning for {dmg} storm damage a second to everything within 5 m. Moving lets the cloud go.

mage_deep_study.name: Deep Study
mage_deep_study.desc: Mana comes back faster, in and out of a fight.

mage_hotter_fire.name: Hotter Fire
mage_hotter_fire.desc: Cinder Bolt burns whiter: more damage per rank.

mage_quick_hands.name: Quick Hands
mage_quick_hands.desc: Shorter casts. Every bolt lands sooner, every cast bar is a smaller window for a skirmisher.

healer_mend.name: Mend
healer_mend.desc: Close a friend's wounds for {dmg}. Works on yourself if nobody is picked. Your steady heal.

healer_smite.name: Sunlash
healer_smite.desc: A lash of sunlight for {dmg} fire damage. Landing it gives back 5 mana, so the light pays for the next heal.

healer_radiance.name: Radiance
healer_radiance.desc: A pulse of warm light heals every friend within 8 m of you for {dmg}, at once. The pack-fight heal.

healer_rebuke.name: Rebuke
healer_rebuke.desc: A sharp word of light for {dmg} fire damage that stops a cast for {secs} seconds. 12 m, no cast time. Does not use the global cooldown.

healer_sanctify.name: Sanctify
healer_sanctify.desc: Bless a patch of ground: friends standing in it when the light lands mend for {secs} seconds. Put it where the tank stands.

healer_clear_water.name: Clear Water
healer_clear_water.desc: Wash a slow, a stun or a poison off a friend and heal them a little ({dmg}).

healer_shelter.name: Shelter
healer_shelter.desc: Throw a shield of light over a friend that absorbs {dmg} damage for {secs} seconds. Instant - the button for the one who just pulled three.

healer_quiet_prayer.name: Quiet Prayer
healer_quiet_prayer.desc: Mana comes back faster, in and out of a fight.

healer_noon_flare.name: Noon Flare
healer_noon_flare.desc: Call the noon sun down on a target: {dmg} fire damage to it and everything within 6 m of it. For swarms, and for playing alone.

healer_steady_light.name: Steady Light
healer_steady_light.desc: Mend heals for more per rank.

wishlist.rule: `cond: "behind"` on an active: the skill is only usable while the player stands in the target's rear 120-degree arc (the angle between the target's facing and the vector target->player is more than 120 degrees). The button is drawn dimmed otherwise and a press says 'Get behind it.' Back Cut needs this; the legendary Twinning Spine (`skillCondition { relax: behind, frontMult: 0.6 }`) relaxes it to any side at 60% damage. Until the engine has it, Back Cut works from any side at full damage and Twinning Spine is inert.

`weaponOnly: "ranged"` (or "melee") on an active: usable only while the equipped main hand is of that class (bow/crossbow = ranged). The button is drawn dimmed otherwise and a press says 'Needs a bow.' Long Draw needs this; without it a dagger rogue pressing Long Draw at 25 m should be refused with 'Out of reach' by the normal range check, which is acceptable but less clear.

`cost: { rage: 40 }, spendAll: true, perResourceSpent: { mult: 0.02 }`: the skill needs at least `cost` to press, then spends the WHOLE bar; each point spent above the cost adds `perResourceSpent.mult` to the weapon multiplier (so 100 rage = x3.0 + 60 x 0.02 = x4.2). This makes Breaker Blow a true rage dump. Until then it is a flat 40-rage hit, which still reads as the dump because the bar visibly empties.

`{ do: "coat", type: "poison", base: [a, b], secs, duration }`: a self-buff for `duration` seconds; every weapon hit the player lands applies (or refreshes) a `dot` of that type/base/secs on the thing hit. With it, Poison Coat becomes a 20 s coat (cost 25 energy, cd 0) instead of a single poisoned strike, and the legendary Hemlock Cord's `skillShareBuff` (coats allies' weapons within 6 m at half duration) works as written. Until then Hemlock Cord needs the text and rule change listed in docs/SKILLS.md.

`charges: n` on an active: the cooldown is per charge (n presses available, each recovering one `cd` at a time, one at a time). The base skills do not use it, but the legendaries Chaser's Greaves and Hourglass Band (`skillCharges`) do, so the engine needs it for the legendaries to work at all.

`who: "self"` allowed on `heal` inside an enemy-target skill (the heal lands on the caster, scaled by healPower). Optional: it would let Sunlash heal the caster for a small amount at high rank; the legendary Dawnbreak already covers the 'smite that heals' fantasy, so this is a nice-to-have, not needed.

`{ do: "zone", shape, size, secs, tick: 1, effects }`: a ground shape that stays for `secs` seconds and applies its inner effects to whoever is INSIDE on each tick, not only at the moment it lands. Optional: Sanctify would become 'stand in the light' (it heals friends who step in later), and Thunderhead would not need a channel. Both skills are written for the instantaneous `area` so they work today.

`{ do: "weapon", mult, normalise: true }`: the hit is `mult x weapon dps x 1.5` (one GCD's worth of the weapon) instead of `mult x one swing`. A maul swings 0.7 a second and a dagger 1.6, so a per-swing skill is 2.3x stronger on a maul than a dagger for the same mult, exactly as in vanilla WoW. Not needed for M9 - the balance targets in docs/SKILLS.md are computed per swing on a sword - but the bot sim will show mauls on top, and this is the one-line fix if the owner does not want that.
